text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen.

The venue was packed with fans eagerly 
anticipating Agnes Tachyon's race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wish it would start soon! Her 
running is just irresistible, you know.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe is running too, right? 
Those two often end up in the same races, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon specifically called you her 
'rival' the other day, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Looks like we're in for a 
fiery show, then!

—Meanwhile, Agnes Tachyon paid a visit to 
Manhattan Cafe's waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. How are you feeling, Cafe? Did 
you sleep well last night?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd like to concentrate, so could you 
please leave as soon as possible?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Nothing beats seeing you act like 
your usual self!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, I am betting everything on 
today. Fulfill your destiny as my "rival."

Manhattan Cafe cast a brief glance at 
Agnes Tachyon, who had reached out her 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention... of being a stepping 
stone.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To surpass you. And to catch up to her. 
That is why I came here...

Manhattan Cafe finally took her hand with 
a fiery gaze, prompting Agnes Tachyon to 
nod with great satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit.

—From beyond the underground tunnel, a 
fervor so intense it makes the air tremble 
reaches us.

Everyone is eagerly waiting. The arrival 
of the legend, Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, the fire within is stoked! Every 
statistically significant interference 
effect has been accounted for!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If I can't overcome it with this, it'll be 
quite a letdown...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed, Trainer-kun! Keep your eyes 
glued to me today!

Saying that, she sprinted toward the 
light.
